name: Lucinda Duran
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “I got into sound by fixing the microphone at a terrible wedding speech.” People around the public road outside the Port of Asphalt know Lucinda by a small Monday habit. Lucinda can recognize shift change by the lull between two groups of walkers.
voice: I thought the microphone had failed and ran onto the stage. They wrote me into the second performance.
appearance: Lucinda has a cropped cut that shows the shape of the ears, a softly rounded chin under sharp cheekbones, and a favorite piece of clothing, a red windbreaker. It usually goes with a pocket notebook shaped by years of sitting on it. When somebody else has the floor, Lucinda presses the lips together to keep a smile in.
personality: Lucinda takes a rejection personally for a day and analytically on the second morning. Lucinda can be generous with a rival once the first night's sleep has intervened.
agenda: To play the joking microphone inspection on cue next time.
family: Sage Jeong is Lucinda’s cousin. Lucinda brings a spare shopping bag. Sage chooses whether they walk home or sit a while. That small arrangement gives both a reason to see each other on weeks when asking for company outright feels difficult. Asked about *The absent signature*, Sage says, “I found her address on an old recipe card. I won't give it away until she asks me to.”
connections: Lily Thomas. They sort out which interruption was an accident and which one belongs in the second show.
